clips.notes: old shepherd at rest: both hands stacked on the staff planted in front of his right side, leaning a little weight on it; slow deep breaths (the stoop lifts on the inhale, one deeper sigh), weight shifts, a slow look round and back, a thoughtful beard-stroke with the left hand; bushy-browed slow blinks; beard and mantle sway late

old but steady: unhurried 82 steps/min, slightly stooped, firm heel strikes; the staff swings forward with the left foot and is PLANTED with it (every other step) - it stays still on the page while the left foot is down, the arm pushing on it; free left arm swings a little; hip bob, head nods late; mantle panels swing with the legs, beard follows

talks plainly: staff planted at his right side, the left hand opens palm-up on the stressed syllables and once comes to his chest; nods on the beats, small head tilts; jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); blinks

peering at the burning bush: leans forward from the hips with the left hand shading his eyes (palm down over the brows), head pushed forward and tilting one way then the other, a slow 'hmm' nod, a small rise onto the toes to see better; staff planted at his side; slow curious blinks

God calls his name: a sharp intake, a small jump on the spot with both hands flying up (left hand open by his face, the staff lifted off the page in his fist), lands with bent knees, eyes wide; settles standing with the staff planted at his side, hand on chest (next: kneel_bow)

humble before the burning bush: a breath, steps the left foot forward and goes down on the right knee (knee on the page, robe folding over it), the staff kept upright at his right side, left hand to his heart, head and back bow low; holds, breathing

'Me? Who am I?': left hand pats his own chest twice, head shakes (no, no), then the shoulders come up in a big helpless shrug with the left palm opening out to the side and the head tilting; a nervous little step back; staff planted in the right hand; worried blinks

'Throw it on the ground': a hesitant look at the staff, lifts it in the right fist (anticipation, weight back), then tosses it down onto the page in front of him - the fist sweeps forward and down and opens at `release` = 0.55 s (the director hides moses/staff and starts the `snake` FX there); follow-through, leans to look at it, hands half up; holds

'Whoa, a snake!': comic hop BACKWARDS 0.06 (rootMotion false: the body ends 0.06 behind the root) with both arms flung up, mantle and beard flying; lands in a crouch, knees bent, leaning forward over the snake and pointing down at it with the left hand, right hand up by his shoulder; holds. Staff hidden (it is the snake)

'Take it by the tail': from the jump_back crouch (feet 0.06 back) a cautious step in, bends low (knees and back) and reaches down with the right hand to y = 0.02 in front, fingers close on the tail (f 20), lifts - the staff is re-shown at 0.9 s upright in his fist - and plants it at his side as he straightens; a relieved breath; ends standing

'All right... I'll go!': a deep breath in (chest and shoulders rise, the stoop straightens), a firm nod, the fist tightens and pulls the staff in close and upright, chin up, a small determined smile; holds standing a little taller

lifts the staff high in the right hand (fist above his head, the staff upright, its foot clear of the page), left arm out to the side with the hand open, chest up, chin up, weight forward on the left foot; a small overshoot and settle; holds (used for 'Let my people go!', the plagues and the finale)

Pharaoh changed his mind again: a long sigh (shoulders rise, then sink), eyes close for a moment, the head shakes slowly three times, left hand rubs his brow once; ends standing, staff planted at his side

'Don't be afraid! Stand still': calm and strong, standing tall (stoop lifted), staff planted firmly at his side, the left palm out toward his listener at chest height with small steadying pushes on the stressed syllables, a slow reassuring nod; jaw talks (lip sync overrides it)

the hero moment: a breath, steps forward onto the left foot, raises both arms forward-up and holds the staff out LEVEL across in front of him above his head (right fist on the grip, left hand further along the shaft), chest lifted, chin up, gazing at the sea; a strong wind from the sea blows the beard to his right, the mantle panels flare back and flap, gusts come and go (strongest ~4 s); the arms brace against each gust; 9 s long to cover the sea_wind FX, ends in a still heroic hold

joining Miriam's song: staff planted in front (as idle), the left palm claps onto the right fist on the staff on every dotted beat, a happy knee-bounce and nod with the beat, head tilting side to side, smiling. Time-scaled in the GLB to exactly one bar of the song (1.0714 s = 32 frames x 1.00446), claps on frame 0 and 16 = the song's dotted beats

grandfatherly: staff planted at his side, gentle slow open-palm gestures with the left hand toward the child (palm up, a soft sweep out), once the hand to his heart, warm head tilts and slow nods, a smile in the eyes; jaw in a slow irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it); slow blinks
a friendly old man's wave with the left hand raised by his head (wrist-led, three waves per loop), staff planted in the right hand; head tilt, smile

vain king at ease: chest out, chin up, weight on one hip then the other, the left hand on his hip, the right hand admires its bracelets once (lifts, turns the wrist, a satisfied little nod), looks down his nose left and right; slow, heavy-lidded blinks; lappets sway
strut: chest out, chin up, high proud knees and pointed toes, big stiff arm swings, a pompous shoulder roll, little bounce; lappets bounce late

pompous speech: big theatrical gestures with both hands in turn (a grand sweep out, a hand to his own chest - 'I!' - a jabbing finger), chin up, head bobbing on the stressed words; jaw in an irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it)
fists on his hips, elbows out, chest out, chin high, looking down his nose; a slow self-satisfied sway side to side, one smug little head-bob, heavy half-closed lids with slow blinks; lappets sway

the boss: a sharp breath in, the left fist goes to his hip, the right arm shoots out straight pointing (whole hand, finger-straight) at the workers, a jab with a lean forward, chin up; overshoot and settle; holds

a huge fake belly laugh: leans back, throws his head back, both hands on his belly, shoulders and belly shake in uneven fading pulses (HA HA HA), wipes an eye, settles into the smug pose (fists on hips, chin up) = frame 0 of `smug`; holds

stubborn 'No!': arms folded high across the chest, chin up and head turned away (nose in the air), the right foot taps impatiently (irregular), one sideways peek back and a 'hmph' re-turn; heavy-lidded blinks

a frog lands on his head: freezes stiff, eyes roll up (head tilts back slowly), a beat, then panics - swats wildly at his head with both hands, hopping on the spot (three hops, knees up, lappets flying); then gives in: both palms out in front pushing 'all right, all right!' twice, leaning back; holds

'Heh heh... changed my mind!': hunches in, rubs his hands together at his chest with a sly sideways look, then straightens, the right hand comes up by his face with the finger straight and wags 'no-no-no' (three wags), head tilted, left hand on the hip; holds the last wag

real sorrow, no comedy: sits on the edge of his dais (hip joint 0.062 up, 0.072 behind the root; the dais step top is 0.030), knees up, elbows on his knees and his face in his hands; very slow heavy breathing with one long shuddering exhale, the head lifts once from the hands to stare at nothing and sinks again, a slow small head shake; lappets hang still

'Wait! Who's going to make my bricks?!': from sitting on the dais (frame 0 = sad_sit pose, hands down) he jumps up, fists balled and shaking by his shoulders, stamps three times (L, R, L - each stamp a big knee lift and a jolt through the body, lappets bouncing), then flings the right arm forward pointing ('After them!'), left fist on the hip; holds

standing in the chariot (hips +0.035: soles on the chariot floor; the chariot stays on the page), fists forward over the front rail holding invisible reins, leaning forward, knees springy - bouncing twice per loop with the rattle, chin up and grinning; the chariot body jiggles a little (wheels stay on the page), the left wheel turns once per loop (= natural speed 0.134 u/s); lappets and back tail blown back

EXTRA: standing in the stopped chariot (hips +0.035), reins in his fists, impatient: drums his fingers, leans to look ahead, bobs on his toes. The director hands a finished locomotion move over to `idle`, which would sink him into the chariot floor - Story should play this after each `ride` move instead

the left wheel is gone (wheelL hidden by the timeline just before): the chariot drops onto its left side (tipping about the right wheel, up to 14 deg), rocks back and drops again; Pharaoh windmills both arms, knees wobbling, then crouches down clinging to the front rail with both hands, head ducked, peeking; holds crouched (soles stay on the tilted chariot floor)

washed up: sitting on the wet sand, legs straight out in front, toes up; slumped, arms hanging, hands limp on the sand by his hips; the nemes lappets droop flat (pulled down/inward), head low; shivers in little bursts (teeth chatter in the jaw), one big shaky sigh, a sulky look up; slow wet blinks

'Ah... ah... ACHOO!': from soggy_sit, two growing inhales (head tips back, chest rises, eyes squeeze), a hold, then a big forward sneeze that jerks the whole upper body forward and down, lappets flapping, a shake of the head, and he slumps back into the soggy_sit pose (ends = soggy_sit frame 0)
furious: fists clenched and shaking at his sides, leaning forward, cheeks puffed (face decal), little stamps of the right foot, head shaking, shoulders up

lively even at rest: light weight shifts with a little knee bounce, hands loosely together, quick glances round (head leads, a curious tilt), tucks the braid back once with her left hand; quick blinks incl. a double; scarf and braid swing late
quick light steps (~129 steps/min): springy bounce, small skips of the heels, arms swinging freely with lagging hands, chest counter-turn, head bright and steady; braid and scarf bounce late
bright and quick: both hands talk (right palm-up offers, left hand to her chest), head tilts and nods on the stressed syllables, a little bounce; jaw in an irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it)

a slave's load: both hands hold a heavy brick against her chest (no brick prop exists in the rig - the hands mime a block 0.045 wide), bent forward under it, knees soft, shuffling in place with tiny heavy steps, hitching the brick up once, a tired head-shake and breath; slow tired blinks

'Oh God... can you hear us?': hands clasped tight at her chest, head bowed, eyes mostly closed, a slow sway, one tremble of the shoulders (holding back tears), lifts her face upward once and bows again

'Everyone, eat up! Shoes on!': bustling - both arms beckon 'come on, come on' in turn (big scooping waves from out-front to her shoulder), looking left then right over the people, bouncing on her toes, a quick step on the spot; scarf and braid swing
'We're free!': a dip, a little hop with both arms flung up (hands open), lands and bounces, laughing (jaw), braid and scarf flying

the sea in front, the chariots behind: hands at her mouth, shoulders up, shrunk back with knees soft, trembling; twice glances back over her shoulder (quick head whip) and back to Moses; quick nervous blinks
the walls of water: a gasp, both hands fly to her cheeks, she leans back with her mouth open and rises onto her toes, delighted, a little overshoot; holds hands on cheeks, beaming

Miriam's song (6/8, dotted quarter 112): the tambourine held high in the left hand, struck by the right palm on every dotted beat (8 hits per loop, marker hitN; the GLB is time-scaled so the loop is exactly 4 bars = 4.2857 s and frame 0 = a downbeat), bouncing step-hops on the beats; bar 3 is a turning hop (the root turns once round on the spot, no translation), bar 4 a high shake with a kick; head bobbing, laughing, skirt swing (hips/thighs), scarf and braid swirl
clips.rootSpin: root bone turns 360 deg about Y in bar 3 (no translation)

clips.notes: a big happy wave with the right hand high (wrist-led, three waves per loop), left hand on her chest, bouncing a little, head tilt
happy clapping in front of her chest, three claps per loop, bouncing on her knees, head bobbing

stage.sadSitNote: sad_sit seat = the dais upper step edge behind PH_PALACE (-0.36, -0.30)
